message: my children are hungry
reply: 🙏 Sorry, I have nothing that I can give you at this time.
reply: 🙇 In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit ❤️✝️🕊️ : 
🙏 May the LORD have His will done! 🕊️ May the LORD feed your children! May the LORD lead you to someone who will abundantly provide whatever you ask the same day you ask! Amen! 🙏
